metadata.title: Minecraft Skin Generator
metadata.description: Describe any Minecraft skin and get it in seconds. A knight, a robot, a ninja cat — type what you imagine and wear it in game.

errors.BAD_REQUEST: Enter a description to make a skin.
errors.CAPACITY: The service is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.NETWORK_FAILED: The connection was lost. Try again.
errors.NO_MATCH: No skin matched that description. Try different words.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment before trying again.
errors.RENDER_FAILED: The skin could not be finished.
errors.SEARCH_FAILED: Skin search is unavailable. Try again.
errors.TEXTURE_MISSING: That skin could not be loaded.
errors.TRANSLATION_FAILED: That description could not be read. Try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session could not be started. Reload the page.

anonymous.title: That skin is yours to keep looking at.
anonymous.body: You have used your 3 free skins. Make a free account for 3 skins a day, saved to your account.
anonymous.note: One tap with Google, Discord or Microsoft. No email to type, no password to remember.

free.title: That is 3 skins today.
free.body: 3 more tomorrow, {when}. Or go unlimited for $4.99 a month and download every skin you make straight into Minecraft.
free.note: Waiting is fine too. Your skins are still here in the morning.

subscription.title: Downloads are part of Unlimited.
subscription.body: Your skin is right there, and it stays there. Putting the file into Minecraft comes with Unlimited — $4.99 a month, as many skins as you like, every one of them downloadable.
subscription.note: Everything you have made stays here either way. Ask a grown-up first — it is a real payment.
